typical.qualification: MODEL ONLY; no RTL, route or rate credit
typical.mapping: count owner occurrences in R; prefix counts -> base[r]; inverse[base[r]+j]=original selected index i
typical.empty_slot: j>=count[r] drains and returns credit without VM write; never reads inverse entry
typical.restore_order: final row i exactly follows original selected list R, including duplicate selections as distinct owned slots
typical.map_payload: 32b protected record: 11b selected i plus reserved validity/identity; bounds checked against K
typical.owner_payload: 32b protected record: 12b base and 12b count; count/base sum checked against K
typical.lookup_mux: 4 independent: owner6:1x39, map3:1x256 and6:1x39; each macro pin and decode boundary registered
typical.build_write: one selected entry per issue, replicated to all four maps; bit-mask39 per record, full readiness guard after build
typical.provider_warning: legacy native SRAM simulation model ignores w_mask_in; not usable for packed-map proof
typical.map_init: no per-op full clear: overwrite every live owner and all K compact records before accepting delivery; slots outside owner count suppressed
typical.build_cycle_basis: two serialized R passes, three cycles per entry per pass including count read/modify/write and inverse publish; owner count initialization and prefix plus16 pipeline/drain
typical.credit_control_protection: 8b remaining count and its complement per lane; mismatch blocks reservation combinationally and latches fault
typical.credit_epoch_completion: opt-in DELCRED waits all128 credits per lane returned before next epoch or done; alwaysaccept transport measurements excluded this drain
typical.credit_round_trip_basis: 35 forward wire +35 return wire +8 lookup +2 VM acknowledgement =80 cycles before arbitration; actual arbitration may extend it and stalls must be measured
typical.fifo_protection: 512b payload as sixteen SECDED39 records +48b protected identity =672b; three256b macros per lane,128 entries
typical.credit_contract: reserve before endpoint delivery selection; return on filtered slot or acknowledged destination; protected counters and overflow/underflow/identity faults mandatory
typical.vm_ack: each64B flit two32B sectors; shared per-bank producer arbiter and routed completion ledger required
typical.vm_bank_conflict: FP32 row stride64sectors aliases row starts at bank0 in VM32; cannot assume four flits accepted per cycle
typical.vm_capacity: K512 FP32 n512 consumes full1MiB VM; live interval admission or separately priced protected destination is required
typical.area_fit_status: SRAM only; clock channels, logic, muxes and consumer storage excluded, floorplan pending
typical.routing_basis: separate pin faces; shared VM boundary and credit return boundary still require route proof
typical.latency_contribution: transport model plus build and lookup/ack; finite-credit and bank-arbitration simulation pending, no latency headline
